name: omniquad_walk
title: OmniQuad walk (residual PPO on a model-based trot; velocity-conditioned)
summary: OmniQuad walks straight and durably (+119 m / 298 s) via residual PPO on a model-based trot, with a velocity-conditioned variant for walk/stop cycles and a terrain-curriculum variant that clears 18 cm rubble. The OmniSim-native RL pipeline's first robot. Same quadruped .npz ghost lineage as go2_walk. NOTE (relabelled 2026-07-12): this skill previously declared `method: shadowing`, which was not accurate -- it has no stored ghost lut and no validator verdict. OmniQuad is NOT YET a Shadowing walk -- but the reason is now MEASURED, not pending. The tooling is ready (build_quad_shadow_ghost.py --robot omniquad builds and validates a OmniQuad ghost; omniquad_shadow_deploy + omniquad_baton_deploy exist; the validator and baton.py needed NO changes). What blocks it is the CHAMPION: this policy's achieved gait is torque-saturated on 210/750 steps (28%) vs the Go2 legacy champion's 21/750 (3%), so folding it yields a ghost with closure p95 81.1 mm against a 20 mm gate -- an UN-FOLDABLE gait (see docs/developer/shadow-iteration.md: Shadowing compounds only from a foldable source). The fix is known and unstarted: give OmniQuad a feasible reference first (the analytic trot is one by construction), train there, and its champion becomes foldable.

ghost.notes: The omniquad walk ghost is a foot-sphere-on-calf trot retarget. Other omniquad ghosts (getup/hill/jump/crouch) are stored .npz under research/shadowing/ghosts/.

baton.notes: Cross-robot cataloguing; not blended with the g1 family.

train.notes: OmniSim-native residual PPO on a model-based gait. See docs/developer/omniquad-residual-rl.md.

deploy.notes: Controller + policy baked into the world; `skill_lib.py run omniquad_walk` launches it.

verification.result: OmniQuad walks +119 m / 298 s straight, 0 falls; terrain variant clears 18 cm rubble (memory project_omniquad_walk_g1_recipe / project_quad_terrain_training_works).
